title: Drill: DNS, Mail, and the Upper Layers

questions.prompt: Which is at the very top of the DNS hierarchy?
options: The root, written as a dot

options: The answer came from a cache
There's no MX but the name exists

questions.prompt: Which dig flag means the answer came straight from an authoritative server?
nslookup is older than dig, and available on every platform including Windows.
